resource.calibration: all service/capacity values assumed, not measured physical hardware

scope.heuristic: same four policy search per design per workload, feasible upper bounds only
scope.phases: equal count of one prefill query tile and one decode query tile; not throughput or full end-to-end
scope.static: one O/m/l placement and one link mask across both phases

capture.scope: Actual layer0 query-head0 only, two shapes; Q/K/V/mask/reference are eager observations; tile m/l/O/alpha are independent NumPy-computed states. Not all heads/layers/models; no calibrated hardware cycles/PPA.
